ICS 65.160FAD 04Reaffirmed 20231. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for pipe tobacco smoking mixtures made from a blend of processed tobacco.1.2 This standard does not cover the requirements for flavour and aroma of pipe tobacco smoking mixtures.2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water - Specification (third revision)5643: 1999 Tobacco and tobacco products - Method of test for tobacco (second revision)10335 : 2016 Glossary of tobacco and tobacco products (third revision)16026 : 2012/ISO 15152 : 2003 Tobacco - Determination of the content of total alkaloids as nicotine - Continuous flow analysis method16132 : 2014/ISO 2881 : 1992 Tobacco and tobacco products - Determination alkaloid content - Spectrometric method16236 : 2014/ISO 2817 : 1999 Tobacco and tobacco products - Determination of silicated residues insoluble in hydrochloride
